**Finding: missing (medium severity) — no vendor performance warranty.**

Section 9 ("Warranties") is purely mutual boilerplate: corporate existence, authority, enforceability and no-conflict (p0056–p0057), plus an HDI acknowledgement about the Globix hosting agreement (p0058). HDI has substantial performance obligations — design, develop, operate, maintain, manage and host the Site (p0005–p0009) — but nothing warrants the quality or conformance of that work. The only quality-adjacent right is a termination right if the Site is not operational within 70 days (p0011), which is a one-time gate, not an ongoing warranty.

Notably, there is no "AS IS" clause or implied-warranty disclaimer anywhere in the agreement, so we are not fighting a disclaimer that would swallow an express warranty — the gap is a clean insertion.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** new Section 9(c) after p0058 giving HDI's warranty that (1) Services are performed in a professional and workmanlike manner, (2) the Site conforms in all material respects to the specifications the Company approves under Section 5.2 for 12 months after the Effective Date, (3) the Services and Site comply with applicable law, and (4) no malicious code; remedy is re-performance/repair/replacement at HDI's option, escalating to a refund of fees if not cured within 30 days.

The comment flags the 90-day/30-day fallback in case HDI resists the 12-month conformance tail.
